summary: Milestone 2026.05.126 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 711 min wall time / 151 experiments (avg 5 min). Slowest paths: Exp 1603 (88 min), Exp 1642 (54 min), Exp 1633 (50 min), Exp 1591 (48 min), Exp 1640 (38 min). Both RTX 3090s were completely idle at 4 MB / 0% utilization throughout, meaning DualGPURunner was not utilized and parallelization was missed. No zombie processes were detected. Estimated 40% savings recoverable via DualGPURunner parallelization and addressing the sequential execution bottlenecks of long-running experiments.
slowest_experiments: 1642: llguidance adapter for reusable external structured- (54min)
1633: Pi-net style differentiable projection layer prototy (50min)
1591: Upgrade DCCD smoke to reusable structured verdict ad (48min)
bottlenecks_identified: Sequential scheduling: 151 experiments ran sequentially without parallel execution.
GPU Underutilization: Both RTX 3090 GPUs (GPU 0 and GPU 1) remained completely idle (0% utilization) despite available capacity.
improvements_suggested: Utilize DualGPURunner to run models on GPU 0 and GPU 1 simultaneously for parallel execution.
Schedule independent experiments concurrently to utilize idle GPU resources.
Investigate and free up the 4MB allocated on GPUs to ensure clean execution state.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Address execution bottlenecks in constraint and projection layer prototypes.
Optimize sequential scheduling into concurrent batches.
meta_reflection: Sequential execution of 151 experiments caused significant delays (711 minutes). Implementing parallel execution via DualGPURunner could save approximately 40% of wall time.
